text:
violet: Heads-up team  quick sync for the AstraGrid customer case. Need interview, hero + expanded quote, legal clearance on perf numbers, gated benchmark PDF, and a short webinar the week after publish. Target publish: Thu next week. Can we lock by Tue EOD?

neil: I can run the interview Mon 9am PT. Will focus on the rollout story, infra config, and the metric deltas.

tara: I'll draft two quote options. One punchy hero line (<12 words) + a longer supporting quote.

oscar: From infra: sanitized snapshot shows median latency down ~62% and p99 down ~2.9x after routing + KV prefix cache. I'll export a redacted CSV for the gated asset.

mina: Sales wants post-publish lead routing to enterprise-inbound@ and AE-queue, tag source=astragrid. Add to publish checklist.

promo-bot: Tentative publish slot reserved: 2026-04-22 09:00 PT  pending legal sign-off and final copy.

violet: Legal constraints reminder: no contract numbers, no raw user counts. Replace absolute counts ("millions") with "large-scale production users" unless AstraGrid confirms exact wording. Also strip any internal dataset names from artifacts.

legal-bot: Please upload signed NDA and the interview consent PDF to https://drive.redwood.work/AstraGrid/ (viewer links). I'll review transcript + CSV after upload. Expect ~48h turnaround.

neil: Interview brief (short):
```
Interviewer: Neil
Length: 20-30min
Goals: customer problem, model + infra config, top 2 metrics changed, one hero soundbite, speaker bio (1 line)
Sample sanitized command for appendix:
./rw_bench --model redwood-open-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --kv-cache --samples 1200 > bench.json
```

tara: Draft quote candidates: 
- hero: "Redwood made our inference predictable at scale."
- long: "Switching to Redwood routing and prefix caching cut our median latency by ~62% and improved p99 nearly 3x, which let us enable lower-latency features for large-scale production users while lowering unit cost."

neil: I'll confirm the hero during the call and get verbatim approval. Also capture a 1-line engineer bio for the webinar page.

oscar: Gated artifact path (staging): /mnt/benchmarks/astragrid/astragrid-redacted-2026-04.csv. Will attach sanitized methodology + CSV to gated PDF.

mina: I'll set up the routing rule post-publish and test on staging. Promo team needs hero quote + speaker name to build webinar page.

promo-bot: Staging webinar page created: /campaigns/astragrid/webinar-staging. Will publish once hero quote is confirmed. Promo plan: announce post + webinar invite + 2 reminders.

legal-bot: Quick note on wording: change any phrasing like "users" counts to qualitative language unless AstraGrid confirms numbers. The command skeleton is fine once internal flags/datasets are removed. I'll sign off after transcript + CSV upload.

violet: Operational checklist: interview scheduled (Neil), consent + NDA uploaded (AstraGrid), hero+long quotes captured (Tara), legal review (legal-bot), gated PDF uploaded (Oscar), post-publish routing tested (Mina), webinar page + promo live (promo-bot). Checkpoint Tue EOD for green light.

sales: On handoff, please include lead-scoring tag "case-study:astragrid" so AEs can prioritize high-intent contacts.

neil: Will post the interview notes and the two quote options to the shared doc after the call.

end of thread
